about: Public toilets per 100,000 residents, one counting rule for every city. Generated by R/E1_peer_city_per_capita.R from data_raw/peer_cities/ (accessed 2026-09-24).
rule: CORE = government-operated or contracted, open to all without purchase, dedicated public toilet (street / park / plaza / transit), listed as operating. Civic-building toilets, portables and urinals are in BROAD; access-scheme businesses are counted separately.

table.core_def: type Sanisette / WC (park & garden toilets) / Lavatory AND statut 'En service'
table.excluded: toilets inside mairies, libraries, museums (not in the list); units 'Hors service'
table.pop_source: INSEE, Populations de référence 2023, population municipale: https://www.insee.fr/fr/statistiques/8643952?geo=COM-75056

table.core_def: Züri WC fixed facilities (wheelchair + non-wheelchair layers), excluding pissoirs; no status field (all listed assumed operating)
table.excluded: none further; list is the city's own (GUD, Umwelt- und Gesundheitsschutz)

table.core_def: resource_type 'restroom' from Rec & Park (174), Public Works Pit Stops (16), Port (14), PUC (1); no status field
table.excluded: street JCDecaux toilets not staffed as Pit Stops appear to be missing; library restrooms not listed (library source has fountains only)
table.pop_boundary: City and County of San Francisco
table.pop_source: US Census ACS 5-yr 2024, table B01003 (same vintage as NYC base)

table.core_def: street APTs (large/small), comfort stations, park field houses, park washrooms, Portland Loos; no status field
table.broad_adds: +28 community centres, +1 aquatic centre, +3 other (VanDusen garden, aquarium plaza), +1 portable

table.core_def: FEHD map_type 'toilet', excluding units whose remark says suspended (temporary or permanent)
table.broad_adds: +31 aqua privies, +122 long-term portable toilets (FEHD), +~630 LCSD park/sports-venue toilets (LegCo 2019, approximate, no list)
table.excluded: LCSD park and sports-venue toilets are NOT in the FEHD list -- the list is PARTIAL for this rule (NYC's core is mostly park toilets)

table.core_def: Parks washroom facilities with Status 1 (open) or 2 (partially open) + automated public washrooms 'Existing'
table.broad_adds: +11 civic buildings with public washrooms (CREM list: 119 washroom rooms)
table.excluded: 41 park washrooms Status 0 (closed for repairs / season / construction) on 2026-09-22; community-centre washrooms not in these lists

table.core_def: Vertrag 1/2/3 (Wall contract, container, other public) AND Symbol 'WC' (not event-only), excluding toilets in civic buildings / cemeteries and sanitary containers
table.broad_adds: + library / Bürgeramt / public-building / museum / cemetery toilets, + containers, + pissoirs
table.excluded: 31 privately operated station/other toilets (Vertrag 4), 13 'Kooperationstoilette' cafés (access scheme), 11 event-only WCs
table.pop_source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg, press release 22 Jun 2026: https://www.statistik-berlin-brandenburg.de/presse/2026/73-bevoelkerungsfortschreibung-2025-berlin/

table.core_def: status Operational AND location_type Park / Public Plaza / Transit (NYC Parks, concessionaires, Hudson River Park, BBP, BPCA, conservancies, DOT/JCDecaux, LIRR/MNR/NYCT)
table.excluded: 13 POPS (privately owned, operated by landlords); 91 not operational / closed / construction
table.pop_source: US Census ACS 5-yr 2024, table B01003 (project base); cached extract us_acs5y2024_b01003_counties_extract.psv

table.core_def: all 74 council-operated toilets in the council list
table.excluded: list last modified 2021-09-30 (stale); LGA is the CBD with a small resident base
table.pop_source: ABS ERP via profile.id.com.au/melbourne/population-estimate (secondary; list is 2021 so years mismatch)
